quote: Accuracy, F1-score, Recall, and Precision are used to evaluate performance in Task 1, a binary classification task where the conclusion C is labeled as either True or False. These metrics compare the predicted labels ŷi against the annotated gold labels y i (True/False). We used Reasoning Accuracy RA to evaluate the models' performance in Task 2 to correctly predict the entailment label ŷi and select the appropriate subset of premises Pi that justify this prediction.
